rawContent: Best #memoir suggestions please? Writing my own on media, #mentalhealth, #MeToo and #motherhood, so anything intersecting with any of these areas particularly welcome - thanks #writing

15 years this week since the event behind this story. 15 years of wondering, wishing, shame, now healing. 15 years of silence, then speaking out, and deciding not to give the man who hurt me the benefit of anything more than blame https://t.co/539Hw6t5HI #metoo @CraftLiterary

This is so powerful. Thank you @kristenchick and @mustardphoto and everyone else who spoke so bravely. I’m sorry you had to experience this.The trauma of living through this should not be underestimated and it’s high time out industry was held accountable for these abuses #MeToo

The other piece I found particularly tough to write this year because it was so personal was 'Dois Irmaos' published by @CraftLiterary in October. Thank you @doylejacq and @katelyn_keating for your extraordinary support #MeToo  https://t.co/539Hw6t5HI

If silence is golden - a poem by me (Hannah Storm) for anyone who’s ever been forced to stay quiet because of what someone else did to them  #MeToo #mentalhealth #poetry #writing https://t.co/u7LYv7ZmOF
I am proud to call the author of this piece my friend. Thank you @nakedvix for calling this out and for showing how we must stop normalising the abnormal @IndyVoices #MeToo
I’m a little late to reading this but encourage anyone who’s ever faced misogyny in the news media to read this from @jenzerb #MeToo  https://t.co/sIQLfVgCwp

Anyone else triggered by some of the reporting of the allegations made by #EvanRachelWood? Yep, #MeToo. She is one brave human, but some of the reporting lacks nuance and understanding of the power exerted by perpetrators long after physical relationships end #coercivecontrol

@LauraPAuthor @schillerrrrr @Sarah_E_Rigby @eandtbooks Ooooh, fascinated by the memoir/non-fiction suggestions, having recently finished my own memoir on motherhood, #MeToo, media and #mentalhealth - pls let me have any recommentdations

Hi @Lilydunnwriter - do you (anyone else) know who might be open to memoir/creative non-fiction (500 words) and will publish with a quick turn around - have written something for #InternationalWomensDay and looking for a #writing #MeToo outlet. Thanks x

Nope. Just can't do this any more today. Too many awful triggers this week. Off Twitter for a break. Men choosing to abuse. I was raped by a man in South America after we stopped at his apartment on way to my hotel. He insisted it was safer inside than on the street. #MeToo
ENOUGH - NO MORE. Let some good come of this collective rage and injustice. How can people who are supposed to protect do this? #SarahEverard #ReclaimTheseStreets #ReclaimTheNight #MeToo
Undercover officers is NOT the answer #ReclaimTheStreets #MeToo

I'd missed this piece until now, but thanks to the @journalismfest for amplifying a much needed conversation @damemagazine https://t.co/w3P7XRrGMW
#metoo

This is a really upsetting read but immensely brave of the women who have shared their stories. Kudos to @thedalstonyears and @Lucy_Osborne and team for this. As a survivor of sexual assault I know how terrifying it can be to break silence and the power that abusers hold #MeToo

Oh my love, you are so brave to write this. How many others of us share stories of the men who abused their power over us and assumed they could straightjacket us into silence - thinking of you and all the other women mistreated by men who think they cam get away with it #MeToo
Please don’t ever underestimate quite how damn hard it is to speak about sexual assault and how brave anyone who speaks about it is #MeToo #mentalhealth
